OCR request returning multiple pages of document content

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { OcrDocument, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.ocr({ document: { type: "document_url", url: "https://example.com/multipage.pdf" } as OcrDocument, model: "mistral/mistral-ocr-latest" });
  console.log(result.pages);
  console.log(result.pages[0].index);
  console.log(result.pages[1].index);
}

void main();
```
